answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy requires each identity to lock a 1000 POA bond for 30 days and complete three distinct tasks. Five independent established peers verify signed logs; fraud, duplicate identities, or replayed proofs burn the bond and trigger a seven-day cooldown. Rotating quorums and two passing rounds make a fake network costly: a thread audit trail, raven anomaly checks, and lantern recovery tests expose coordinated agents.
